state.product: GrapiX: broadcast graphics (Rust, Windows first). Every process writes its own JSON-lines log under one log root, one folder per product and one file per run, with a version and build on each run. Credentials never reach a log (invariant 54); tests check it.
state.row: 2.14: a diagnostic bundle. `gx-diag` (a command) and a menu item in each of the two windowed shells collect the last N hours of every process log, the as-run log, versions and build hashes, the capability surface, the device and adapter, the sanitised configuration and the recovery journal into one archive for a bug report.
state.done_when: A bundle from a conformance run holds every process log, the as-run log, versions and build hashes, the capability surface and the sanitised configuration, and no credential.
state.facts: The as-run log is row 12.11, which is not built: no as-run file exists anywhere. The bundle is read by an engineer and by the operator who may open it on any Windows machine (Explorer must open it). The `zip` crate is already used for scene packages with zstd members only; Explorer cannot open zstd members; the deflate feature of the same crate needs no new download (flate2 and miniz_oxide are in the lockfile and cache). A log file is whole (a rotated file is up to 50 MB) and its sequence numbers run without gaps, so cutting a file by time would break that. The recovery journal holds published scene documents (customer graphics). The Playout shell has no dialog dependency; the Editor shell has one; a new dependency needs the user's approval. Windows is built first; other platforms wait. A credential in a log would be a bug, never expected.

options_credential.redact_and_report: The collector scans every collected byte for the credential shape (gx1. followed by two base64 segments) and for the values of known secrets, replaces each in the copy with a marker, counts them per file, and says so in the manifest and on its exit status, because a credential in a log is itself a bug worth raising.
options_credential.refuse_to_write: If any credential is found the collector writes no bundle and names the file and line, so the bug is fixed before anything leaves the machine.
options_credential.trust_the_logs: Do not scan: invariant 54 and the log tests already keep credentials out; scanning twice is redundant.

options_as_run.include_if_present_name_if_not: Include every as-run file in the window when there is one; when there is none, the manifest names the absence and why (row 12.11 is not built), and the evidence names the reading of the done-when openly.
options_as_run.build_12_11_first: Do not close 2.14 until the as-run record exists, since the done-when says the bundle holds it.
options_as_run.empty_placeholder: Always write an as-run section in the bundle, empty when there is no log, with no further note.

options_files.whole_files_in_window: Include every log file last written within N hours, whole, so each file keeps its own unbroken sequence; the manifest names each file and its first and last timestamps; a total size cap names what was left out.
options_files.cut_by_record_time: Include only the records inside the window, cutting files at the first record in range.

options_menu.write_to_log_root_and_reveal: The menu item writes the bundle to a bundles folder beside the logs and reveals it in Explorer; no dialog, no new dependency; the result and path are logged.
options_menu.save_dialog: The menu item opens a save dialog and the operator chooses the place; needs a dialog dependency in the Playout shell.
options_menu.desktop: The menu item writes the bundle to the Desktop and says nothing else.

options_archive.zip_deflate: A zip with deflate members, opened by Explorer anywhere; enables an existing crate feature, no new download.
options_archive.zip_stored: A zip with stored (uncompressed) members: opens anywhere, large.
options_archive.zip_zstd: A zip with zstd members like scene packages: small, but Explorer cannot open it.
